overview_description.description:
Partnered provides sponsorship management solutions. It offers MANAGE, a tool for brands to receive sponsorship requests, collaborate to make efficient decisions, and manage existing sponsorship relationships.

The company was founded in 2010 and is based in San Francisco, California.
